text:
Type: two-tone wooden dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: solid pine, antique-stained seat, painted frame
Colors: light warm grey frame, light honey-brown wood seat
Shape: curved top rail, center bow-tie splat with a round cutout, flat solid seat, square straight legs with an H-shaped stretcher, upright frame, medium visual weight
Feel: homely, gentle, country, warm
Goes with: pine or grey painted tables, cream walls, checked or floral textiles; farmhouse kitchens, cottage dining rooms

product.name: GAMLEBY
product.description: Easy to move thanks to the hole in the backrest.
